title: Sewer backing up?

scenes.say: Water coming up through the basement drain?
scenes.visual: dark water rising around a floor drain in a concrete basement floor

scenes.say: Stop running water anywhere in the house.
scenes.visual: a hand turning off a kitchen faucet, close up

scenes.say: No showers, no laundry, no dishwasher.
scenes.visual: a washing machine in a basement laundry area, turned off, dim light

scenes.say: Do not pour chemical cleaner into a blocked line.
scenes.visual: a plastic bottle of drain cleaner left unopened on a shelf

scenes.say: Notice which fixtures are backing up.
scenes.visual: a bathroom with a toilet and tub, water sitting high in the tub drain

scenes.say: If sewage is coming into the house, call any time.
scenes.visual: a phone lighting up on a kitchen counter at night
a clean white plumbing service van parked on a quiet small-town street at dusk, warm lights in the houses

caption: Sewer backup? Stop running water and call. We clear it and find out why it happened.
